about.title: About Thought Diary App
about.subtitle: An AI-powered journal for better mental health
about.description1: Thought Diary App is an AI-powered tool designed to help you track and analyze your thoughts and emotions. Based on the principles of Thought Diaries, our application helps you identify and challenge negative thinking patterns, promoting healthier mental habits.
about.description2: By analyzing your diary entries with advanced sentiment analysis, you can gain insights into your emotional patterns and work towards improved well-being.
about.feature1Desc: Create, edit, and organize your thought diary entries with ease.
about.feature2Desc: Automatic analysis identifies positive and negative thinking patterns.
about.feature3Desc: View insights and trends about your emotional patterns over time.
about.feature4Desc: Your data is encrypted and protected with industry-standard security.
about.creditsText: Built with Vue 3, TypeScript, and Flask. Sentiment analysis powered by GitHub Models API.
